trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this unlocks automatically. Everything is offline and single-player, one playthrough is enough, and PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 at about 200 hours. There is no online trophy and no difficulty setting to worry about.

trophies.guide: Finish the in-game 100% checklist (Progress, Stats, 100% Completion), which appears after the story — earlier progress counts. PowerPyx calls this the hardest trophy, but the thresholds are lenient: it is roughly 60% of true completion, and most of it comes from doing the other trophies. Two of its counts are pinned down: scan 200 of the 277 Base Model Vehicles and study 100 of the 255 Animals by looking at them through the binoculars. Leave this for last; it fills itself in while you clean up.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: Official trophy description, as published on PlayStation

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts anywhere in Leonida: jumps, near misses and the like all count, and the tracker shows your count under Touchpad, Progress, Activities. Stunts are one of the game's 9 activity types, so every stunt also feeds Master of None. Just stunt whenever you drive and the number climbs on its own.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: Official trophy description, as published on PlayStation

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once each: Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Ranges, Pool, Basketball (scoring hoops), Playing a Video Game, Win a Car Race / Race Challenge / Top Fun Drone Race, and Perform a Stunt. Check them off under Touchpad, Progress, Activities, which shows how many of each you have done. One try each is enough — no wins needed except where the activity itself is a race.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge: 12 range locations holding 42 challenges in total, per PowerPyx's range guide. Visit each range, learn its targets, and replay a challenge until the gold score lands. No other trophy depends on the ranges, so take them at your own pace.

trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have a strand ending in a final mission, and more strangers wait around the map. Work through the strands as you find them; the five named finals alone are more than half the count.

trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia. THIS IS THE ONLY TROPHY ANY GUIDE FLAGS AS POSSIBLY MISSABLE. The first meditation spot is offered at Jason's house in Chapter 1 and becomes permanently unavailable after that chapter, so do it in Chapter 1 before you finish the chapter. After that, work through the remaining spots as you explore; each meditation is a short sit-down at a marked spot.

trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. His optional questline gets marked some time after Chapter 2, main mission Coffee Break. During his first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69; use it to take down the unique animal he points you at. Hunting is one of the 9 activity types.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: Official trophy description, as published on PlayStation
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the game's photo-tagging activity: find the marked spots around Leonida and snap them. Work through the map region by region and the count climbs steadily to 100.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: Official trophy description, as published on PlayStation

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges from the game's challenge list. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and activities, so they fill in while you chase the other trophies. Check the challenge list in-game and pick off the easy ones first if you want to finish it early.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: Official trophy description, as published on PlayStation

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, raise a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose the cops and escape the heat together. Break line of sight, get out of the search area, and stay hidden until the stars clear. Easiest in the countryside, away from dense police patrols.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: Official trophy description, as published on PlayStation
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back in one run without losing your Wanted Level. Pick three shops close together, hit them in quick succession, and keep moving so the cops never catch up. Plan the route first, then run it in one go.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: Official trophy description, as published on PlayStation

trophies.guide: Discover 100 distinct vehicles by driving them. Every new vehicle you get into counts, and it feeds the 100% checklist too, which wants 200 of the 277 Base Model Vehicles scanned. Drive everything you see: traffic, parked cars, bikes, boats and aircraft all add to the count.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: Official trophy description, as published on PlayStation
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus and take down 5 enemies before it ends. Pick a fight with a group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns while it lasts. A crowded shootout is the easiest place to line up five.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: Official trophy description, as published on PlayStation
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Go to Vice City International Airport, steal a plane, and take off without a flight plan — an unscheduled departure. Expect a Wanted Level on the runway, so get airborne fast and the trophy pops once you are up.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: Official trophy description, as published on PlayStation

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank and drive it. Tanks sit at Mile Zero Air Station in the south of the map; they are unlocked and you can simply drive one away, which brings a 3-star Wanted Level. Once you are rolling in the Rhino, the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected: go in quiet, avoid the cameras and the guards' sightlines, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. A stealth approach is the whole trick — if you are spotted, leave and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: Official trophy description, as published on PlayStation

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vaults are the big heist-style robberies; hit one, get out clean, and repeat until you have five. A fast getaway vehicle parked nearby makes every escape easier.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: Official trophy description, as published on PlayStation

trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run routes around Leonida; stop one, crack it open, take the cash and get away before the police close in.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.name: Official trophy description, as published on PlayStation

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida until the whole map is uncovered. Drive, fly and sail into each corner of the state; the trophy pops when the last area registers as visited. Pair it with the WAiNK It spots and card hunting so the exploring does double duty.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: Official trophy description, as published on PlayStation
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. Every gang runs its own operations around the map; hit one per gang and the trophy is done. The gangs' territories are the clue to where each operation sits.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: Official trophy description, as published on PlayStation

trophies.guide: Go to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and enjoy the view.
